name: Vitauthority
description: Supplement brand selling vitamins, collagen, protein powders and other health products for everyday wellness routines.

evidence.summary: Lasso lists the Vitauthority affiliate program at 15% per sale with a 14-day cookie; the join link routes to ShareASale.

opportunity.summary: Open ShareASale program at a mid-teens rate across a broad supplement catalog.
risks: 14-day cookie is short
No published earnings cap found, so the cap is recorded as unknown

reasons.niche_fit: Broad supplement catalog fits general wellness content.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Active affiliate recruitment through a major network, but no creator program page was captured.
reasons.compensation: 15% per sale is a solid mid-range supplement rate.
reasons.contact_access: No public partnerships email was captured; contact runs through ShareASale.
reasons.credibility: Established DTC supplement brand; terms come from a directory listing rather than a brand page.

name: BioTrust
description: Premium natural nutrition brand founded by Joel Marion and Josh Bezoni, selling protein powders, collagen, probiotics and other supplements.

evidence.summary: LinkClicky (listing updated March 10, 2024) lists BioTrust on CJ Affiliate at 12% commission per sale ($0-$18 per sale), US region, with joining through CJ.

opportunity.summary: Established nutrition brand running its affiliate program through CJ at 12%.
risks: Directory listing last updated March 2024; confirm live terms inside CJ before promoting
No published earnings cap found, so the cap is recorded as unknown

reasons.niche_fit: Core supplement categories map cleanly to wellness content.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Long-running network program; no creator-specific page captured.
reasons.compensation: 12% per sale via CJ is mid-range for supplements.
reasons.contact_access: No public partnerships email captured; contact runs through CJ.
reasons.credibility: Well-known premium nutrition brand founded by named founders.

name: InsideTracker
description: Blood biomarker analysis platform that turns blood test results into personalized nutrition, fitness and lifestyle recommendations, used by athletes and longevity-focused consumers.

evidence.summary: InsideTracker's own Collabs page invites health, wellness and fitness partners and lists affiliate marketing, discount codes, content creation and usage rights as partnership opportunities.
Lasso lists the InsideTracker Preferred affiliate program at 8% per sale.
Afflemi lists InsideTracker at around 8% per sale through Awin (also in-house), with manual review via Awin approval.

opportunity.summary: Science-led biomarker platform with an Awin affiliate route at 8% plus a brand-run collabs program.
opportunity.audience_fit: Longevity, biohacking, endurance and performance audiences.
risks: High product price point can slow conversion
No published earnings cap found, so the cap is recorded as unknown

reasons.niche_fit: Biomarker testing is a strong fit for health-optimization creators.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Brand-run ambassador/collabs page plus a network program.
reasons.compensation: 8% per sale is modest, partly offset by high order values.
reasons.contact_access: Published sales email and a dedicated collabs page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open Awin application with manual review plus direct collabs route.

name: Biostrap
description: Wearable health platform tracking sleep, recovery, heart rate variability and activity, sold with a subscription analytics app.

evidence.summary: Biostrap's own affiliates page (page metadata last updated 2022-03-08) describes a Tapfiliate-run program applied for at affiliates.biostrap.com: option 1 gives customers a unique 10%-off code and pays the affiliate 10% commission after each sale; approval requires completing Biostrap Academy courses; payouts are monthly via PayPal once the commission balance reaches $101.

opportunity.summary: Brand-direct wearable affiliate program paying 10% on code-driven sales, tracked on Tapfiliate.
opportunity.audience_fit: Sleep, recovery, HRV and quantified-self audiences.
risks: Program page metadata was last updated in March 2022, so confirm the program is still active before creating content
Approval requires completing Biostrap Academy courses
No published earnings cap found, so the cap is recorded as unknown

reasons.niche_fit: Sleep and recovery wearables fit health-tech creators well.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Detailed brand-run affiliate page with a structured onboarding path.
reasons.compensation: 10% commission on a premium wearable is reasonable.
reasons.contact_access: Published affiliate support email on the program page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application, but gated by required Academy coursework.
reasons.credibility: Program page appears stale (2022 update metadata), which lowers confidence.

name: VIM & VIGR
description: Compression legwear brand selling stylish compression socks for travel, work, sport and everyday leg health.

evidence.summary: VIM & VIGR's own affiliate page states bloggers join through ShareASale (Merchant ID 72414) and earn 15% commission on every sale their site drives, paid through ShareASale; influencers are routed to its Aspire creator program.

opportunity.summary: Niche compression-legwear brand paying 15% via ShareASale, with a separate Aspire route for social creators.
opportunity.audience_fit: Travel, nursing/healthcare, running and standing-all-day audiences.
risks: Narrow product category limits content range
No published earnings cap found, so the cap is recorded as unknown

reasons.niche_fit: Compression legwear is a focused health niche with clear use cases.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Own page runs both an affiliate route and an Aspire influencer route.
reasons.compensation: 15% of the total order amount is a healthy rate for apparel-adjacent health products.
reasons.contact_access: Clear application routing on the brand's own page, though no email was published there.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open ShareASale application with brand review.
reasons.credibility: Established specialty brand with first-party program terms.

name: Physician's Choice
description: Gut-health supplement brand selling probiotics and related digestive formulas, reporting more than 6 million units sold.

evidence.summary: Lasso lists the Physician's Choice affiliate program at 25% per sale with a 90-day cookie.

Maxfunnels' dedicated program page reports 25% per sale (product-specific), a 90-day cookie, a $100 minimum payout and the Refersion network, with applications reviewed manually on the brand's website. Rate conflict: an older Maxfunnels roundup cites 20% with a two-month cookie, and a FlexOffers listing (marked deactivated, January 2025) cited 8% with a 30-day cookie, so the rate is recorded as null until confirmed inside Refersion.

opportunity.summary: Popular probiotic brand on Refersion; two dedicated listings report 25% but older and deactivated listings conflict, so the rate needs in-network confirmation.
opportunity.audience_fit: Gut health, bloating and digestive wellness audiences.
risks: Published rates conflict (25% vs 20% vs a deactivated 8% listing); confirm the live rate inside Refersion before promoting
Manual application review
No published earnings cap found, so the cap is recorded as unknown

reasons.niche_fit: Probiotics are a core wellness-creator category.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Multiple affiliate directories track an active program.
reasons.compensation: Headline 25% is strong but unverified against conflicting listings, so it is scored conservatively and recorded as null.
reasons.contact_access: No public partnerships email captured; applications run through the brand site.
reasons.credibility: Large, well-known gut-health brand; rate documentation is inconsistent across sources.
